description: A blue bedspread and a pink pillow are in front of you, with a white plastic, plane-shaped model and a couple of small white block pieces lying on the bed. The left hand steadies the white model near its center while the right hand reaches in from the right, pinches a small rectangular block from the top of the model, lifts it up and away, then carries it down toward the lower right to set it aside, leaving the model as a left-hand object and the block as a right-hand object briefly before release.
